name: The White Castle

categories.label: Track points
categories.hint: Clan Points collected on the score track during play (laps included).

categories.label: Coins and seals
categories.hint: Coins + Daimyo seals together: 1 pt per 5 (round down).

categories.label: Resources
categories.hint: Remaining units per resource (0-7): 3-6 units = 1 pt, 7 = 2 pts each type.

categories.label: Passage of Time
categories.hint: 0 (season 1), 3 (season 2), 6 (season 3) or the 10-15 printed on the space in season 4.

categories.label: Courtiers
categories.hint: Courtiers in castle: gate 1, first floor 3, second 6, third 10 each.

categories.label: Training yards
categories.hint: Total warrior value × courtiers inside castle, excluding gate.

categories.label: Gardens
categories.hint: Sum of Clan Points printed on each Gardener card occupied.

categories.label: Final turn order
categories.hint: Final turn-order position (1 = first). Tiebreak only.

sources.title: The White Castle English rulebook (Devir) - image PDF, read visually
sources.section: p.14 End of the Game; p.15 scoring example

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Verified vs official rulebook p.14-15 (page images read). Final scoring after round 3: coins+seals /5, resources (3-6 units=1, 7=2 per type), Passage of Time, Courtiers by floor, Training Yards (warrior value x courtiers inside castle, yard value 1 or 2 per warrior), Gardens (value printed on card). Warrior and garden values are printed on components so are scorer inputs. Highest total wins; tie goes to the player higher in turn order. Solo and Matcha expansion not modelled.

tiebreakers.description: Higher in the final turn order (position 1 = first) wins.
